mapper.sql: eqp_key, control_state, eqp_state, since_at, reason_code, reason_detail, updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO tc_eqp_state (eqp_key, control_state, eqp_state, since_at, reason_code, reason_detail) VALUES (#{s.eqpKey}, #{s.controlState, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{s.eqpState, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, #{s.sinceAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, #{s.reasonCode}, #{s.reasonDetail})
mapper.update: UPDATE tc_eqp_state SET control_state = #{s.controlState, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, eqp_state = #{s.eqpState, typeHandler=org.apache.ibatis.type.EnumTypeHandler}, since_at = #{s.sinceAt, typeHandler=com.nori.tc.db.mybatis.common.typehandler.OffsetDateTimeTypeHandler}, reason_code = #{s.reasonCode}, reason_detail = #{s.reasonDetail}, updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE eqp_key = #{s.eqpKey}
